segment_contamination_dimensions: Residential/domestic housing buyers — siblings such as Prefabricated Houses, Wooden House, Portable House, Container Homes, and Mild Steel Portable House target buyers seeking permanent or semi-permanent residential dwellings; Portable Resort targets hospitality/commercial operators deploying accommodation for paying guests, not personal residence.

Utility/security structure buyers — siblings such as Guard Huts, PVC Guard Huts, Bunkhouses, and Bunk House Office target industrial/security/labour-camp operators; names implying guard, security, labour, or office use are blocked.

Residential log/timber home buyers — siblings Log Homes, Log Cabin, and Prefabricated Wooden House target buyers seeking permanent timber residences; names framing the product as a personal home or permanent dwelling are blocked.

Generic prefab hut buyers — siblings Portable Huts, Prefabricated Hut, and Bamboo Huts attract buyers seeking low-cost utility shelters without hospitality intent; names that strip the hospitality/resort framing are blocked.
